What this demonstration does—and does not show

It searches a small, hand-written equation graph and calculates alternative solutions. The relation K = p²/(2m) is derived by substituting v = p/m into K = ½mv²; it is not an additional independent law. Each route lists its measurements and algebraic steps. Routes sharing measurements are not independent experiments.

This is a companion to the research, not the trained 305-node GNN and not evidence that the GNN uses these steps. Agreement is an algebra check, not proof of a new law. Differing answers flag inconsistent inputs; the demo does not choose which measurement is correct.

Physical scope: a constant-mass point particle in nonrelativistic classical mechanics. F is the net force magnitude, a the acceleration magnitude, p the momentum magnitude, and K translational kinetic energy. All quantities refer to the same object, instant, and inertial reference frame. Zero, negative, relativistic, rotational-energy, and variable-mass cases are outside this demo.

THE MISSION / MD MINNATULLAH

“I see physics as a graph
of nodes and relationships.”

I’m an independent researcher from Supaul, Bihar. Without access to a laboratory or research funding, I started with synthetic data and a graph of physical quantities, equations, and laws.

My immediate goal is to teach AI to solve for a quantity through different valid routes, even when some information is missing. My longer-term ambition is AI that helps discover new physics—but any proposed relationship must survive mathematical checks and independent measurements.
